title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an operator of a configured identity provider could authenticate as an existing…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an operator of one configured external identity provider can authenticate as an existing user associated with a different configured identity provider. This occurs because Splunk SOAR authenticates accounts by username without verifying the identity provider ownership, allowing potential privilege escalation if the targeted user has the Administrator role. The vulnerability requires multiple configured identity providers with distinct trust domains and overlapping usernames.
